title: Benjar Pranic
description: Benjar Pranic was an Ishi Tib pirate who served under both Captain Silvo and Captain Brutus and had a respect for the mad scheming of Silvo. When Jod Na Nawood returned to Starport Borgo to retrieve SM-33, Pranic was there, divining the entirety of his old captain's scheme and although he seemed to admire it, he also had no hesitation in pulling the alarm.
